title: Add launch-time scene light intensity scaling
objective: Add a programmatic launch-time control for existing scene light intensity so generated worlds can keep indoor fixtures but dim them enough for the co-located flashlight to be visible.
instructions: Add a CLI option such as --scene-light-intensity-scale with default 1.0 to both examples/flashlight/run.py and examples/flashlight/run_orbit_collection.py.

Apply the scale programmatically at launch to existing scene light components before or independently of spawning the co-located flashlight. The co-located flashlight intensity must not be scaled by this option.
Keep --disable-scene-lights behavior intact; scale is for dimming real scene lights when they remain enabled. Validate finite non-negative values, allowing 0.0 as a dim-to-off option.
Update tests for argument defaults and invalid values. Update flashlight README with concise cafeteria v2 examples showing scene lights dimmed rather than disabled.
Do not create commits or perform Git operations.
expected_outputs: Changed files, verification commands/results, and example commands for scene-light dimming.
definition_of_done: Both flashlight entry points can dim existing scene lights at launch without changing the co-located flashlight intensity; tests/docs are updated; no commit is created.
